title: Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica Part 3

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane governed nominally by the Azorius Senate and home to the guilds.

entities.name: Rakdos Cult
entities.description: A guild of hedonists, sadists, criminals and psychopaths led by the demon Rakdos, combining destruction with the pursuit of pleasure.

entities.name: Rakdos the Defiler
entities.description: A capricious, megalomaniacal demon who has lived thousands of years and is the undisputed head of the Rakdos Cult.

entities.name: Rix Maadi
entities.description: The Rakdos guildhall built around a lava pit in the undercity, where Rakdos dwells.

entities.name: Demon's Vestibule
entities.description: The ancient subterranean passage and stone staircase leading down to Rix Maadi.

entities.name: Rings of Rakdos
entities.description: Shifting conglomerations that pay tribute to Rakdos, each led by a Ringmaster; nine major Rings exist.

entities.name: Bloodwitches
entities.description: A cadre of powerful witches in Rix Maadi who are the closest thing to advisors Rakdos has.

entities.name: Exava
entities.description: The bloodwitch who currently wields the most power in the Rakdos Cult.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: A Rakdos figure whose spikers are notorious for random acts of violence.

entities.name: Riot Mages
entities.description: Rakdos mages who lead the festivals.

entities.name: Spikers
entities.description: The muscle of Rakdos, employed by each Ringmaster.

entities.name: Madcaps
entities.description: The entertainers of Rakdos, many of them homicidal deviants.

entities.name: Roustabouts
entities.description: Cult members who staff clubs and assist riot mages.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Ravnica's ostensible government, which sees itself as mediator and controller of the other guilds.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: The sphinx who is guildmaster of the Azorius, persuaded to lead as crime and chaos grew without the Guildpact.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The pact that bound the guilds, now dissolved.

entities.name: Sova Column
entities.description: The judiciary-like Column of the Azorius.

entities.name: Jelenn Column
entities.description: The legislative Column of the Azorius.

entities.name: Lyev Column
entities.description: The Column that enforces and puts laws into practice, to which most of the Azorius military belongs.

entities.name: Prahv
entities.description: The original Azorius guildhall, demolished when the Parhelion crashed into it.

entities.name: New Prahv
entities.description: The new Azorius guildhall of three towering columns, the tallest structures on the ground in Ravnica.

entities.name: Parhelion
entities.description: The Boros warship that crashed into the original Prahv.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A guild whose warship demolished Prahv.

entities.name: Forum of Azor
entities.description: A huge flat public forum where any Ravnican can be heard; its magic was lifted by Isperia's decree.

events.summary: Rakdos, previously dumped unconscious into his lava pit, has awakened and been restored to full power.
events.quote: But now, Rakdos has awakened and is restored to his full power.

events.summary: When Rakdos slumbers, the cult calms and bloodwitches vie for control; when he wakes the bloodletting resumes.
events.quote: Then Rakdos wakes up, and it's an orgy of bloodletting and mayhem again.

events.summary: The original Prahv is demolished when the Boros warship Parhelion crashes into it.
events.quote: The original Prahv, the so-called Spires of Order, was demolished when the Boros warship Parhelion crashed into it.

events.summary: Isperia is convinced to lead the Azorius as crime and chaos grow without the Guildpact.
events.quote: Isperia decided her service was needed enough to trump her preferences.

events.summary: The Azorius revive the trias politica of three Columns after the Guildpact dissolves and Prahv is rebuilt.
events.quote: the Azorius revivified the concept, and it has become deeply meaningful and reflective of the guild's structure and hierarchy.

events.summary: New Prahv is built once popular support grows and Isperia accepts leadership of the guild.
events.quote: Only once popular support built up and Isperia accepted the leadership of the guild did the gears of reconstruction begin to turn.

events.summary: Isperia decrees the magic lifted from the Forum of Azor, reviving it as a chaotic public space.
events.quote: Isperia decreed that the magic be lifted from the Forum

relations.quote: Rakdos the Defiler is the undisputed head of the guild
